title: minifier: remove duplicate selectors
impact: 2 reactions; filed by a member, who couldn't name real code that has it (maintainer asked). 0 duplicate selectors in all 9 real-corpus files after minification. But the minifier itself creates duplicates when it appends selectors of an adjacent rule with the same declarations: `.a,.b{color:red}.b{color:red}` -> `.a,.b,.b{color:red}`, which makes it slightly more real than 'clerical error'.
summary: Exact duplicate selectors in a list (`h1,h2,h3,h1,h3`) are kept on master and 1.31.1-1.33.0. Removing exact duplicates is safe: identical selectors match the same elements with the same specificity. The reporter's second example (`div.class,.class`) must NOT be reduced: `div.class` has higher specificity than `.class` (browser-verified: dropping it flips the winner against a later `.class` rule).
evidence: repro.mjs on local (master 8865c3d), 1.33.0, 1.32.0, 1.31.1: identical, all 3 wanted cases WRONG, 2 controls correct. equivalence.mjs (Chromium): `h1,h2,h1{}` vs `h1,h2{}` EQUIVALENT; `div.foo,.foo{color:blue}.foo{color:red}` vs `.foo{color:blue}.foo{color:red}` DIFFERENT (exit 1). Corpus scan (scratchpad/triage/analyze-merge.mjs) over target/review/real-corpus: 0 duplicate selectors in any file.

fix.approach: Drop exact duplicates (Selector PartialEq, not a serialized string) in StyleRule::minify and also when merge_style_rules appends selectors from an adjacent rule (skip selectors already present). Keep the first occurrence. Never remove subsumed-but-different selectors.

openPRs.assessment: Stale (March 2024, no reviews). Dedups in StyleRule::minify only, so it misses duplicates created afterwards by merge_style_rules (`.a,.b,.b`). Uses `selector.to_css_string()` + HashSet for every selector of every rule: an allocation per selector in the minify hot path; comparing with Selector's PartialEq (lists are short) or skipping when len<2 would avoid it. One test. Fine as a starting point; needs the merge-path dedup and a perf tweak.

notVerified: Didn't build PR #696. Selectors that serialize the same but differ structurally (e.g. after nesting/`:is()` lowering, vendor-prefix expansion) not explored.
